Raphael Bentvelzen, founder of Venio

Venio is a Paris-based digital studio that designs and builds bespoke websites and platforms, and publishes its own products.

Raphael has been creating websites and platforms for over fifteen years. He personally designs and develops the ones presented here, from the first sketch to launch, and works directly with business owners. You speak to the person who will build your software.

How Venio works

Bespoke, with no imposed software

No fixed template or third-party software dictating what is possible. You own the code.

People who make decisions

We clarify, structure and decide. Every deliverable serves a written objective, not a passing trend.

Your freedom to leave, in writing

Full data export, transferable source code and documentation supplied. You can leave whenever you want.

Platforms built by Venio

Five products, all designed and developed in-house. The first three are in use or accessible online.

Arrow

A management platform for groups of private schools and training centres across multiple campuses.

Online app.arr0w.app
Since December 2025
In use

One application for an unlimited number of institutions, each with its own web address, colours, users and data kept separate from the others. This is exactly the architecture we propose for a group of galleries.

  • Timetables, attendance, grades, report cards and diplomas
  • Administrative documents, templates and automated delivery
  • Sales tracking from first contact to enrolment, and email campaigns
  • Invoicing, online payments, accounting and VAT
  • Role-based permissions, invitations and a complete activity history
  • Each institution's own brand and web address
  • An interface in six languages, including right-to-left Arabic
  • Integration with the institution's other software

What this demonstratesWe can deliver and run a platform that hosts multiple institutions under one roof, with integrated invoicing, documents and sales tracking. A demo campus is available to visit by appointment.

Venio

Our public website, client portal and workspace in a single application.

Online venio.paris
Since February 2025
In use

Venio clients use it to track quotes, progress on each phase, change requests, documents and invoices. On our side, the same tool handles sales tracking, projects and accounting. The platform we propose for galleries is built on these foundations.

  • Client portal: quotes to accept, progress, requests, files and invoices
  • Our workspace: sales tracking, projects, requests, calendar and messaging
  • Accounting and electronic invoicing in the format required by the French authorities
  • Two-step sign-in and a complete activity history
  • Automated integration with our clients' websites

What this demonstratesThe document vault, electronic invoicing and client portal we propose already exist and run here every day. Demo access is available.

Yumi

An online CV builder designed for recruiters and the software that screens applications.

Online yumicv.com
Model free, then paid
Published by Venio
Open to the public

Two versions of a CV created at once: a polished layout for people, and a structured version for screening software. A built-in assistant, wording suggestions and checks for common mistakes.

What this demonstratesWe can design, launch and maintain a paid consumer product, as well as bespoke client projects.

Virendys

Patient management software for private clinics in France and Switzerland.

Markets France and Switzerland
Status pre-pilot, fictional data
Pre-pilot

Our most demanding project for security and privacy: one practice's data is invisible to other practices, with separation enforced by the database itself, not just by what the screen displays. Sign-in uses two steps, every record access is logged, and patients can retrieve their complete file in a standard format.

What this demonstratesWhen you ask for one gallery's contracts to remain invisible to the group's other galleries, we have already built that level of separation. We check it automatically with every software change.

Sei

A health and performance tracking app connecting personal monitoring, the practitioner and their recommendations.

Roles client, practitioner, administrator
Status delivery in progress
In progress

Questionnaires, assessments, documents, summaries and recommendations: each profile has its own space, workflows follow defined steps, and every significant event is recorded.

What this demonstratesWe can organise sensitive data within controlled workflows, exactly what artwork movements, consignments and certificates require.
